title: ReproBridge: Building Reproducibility into ML Research Artifacts
abstract: arXiv:2611.08452v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reproducing machine learning experiments requires reconstructing procedures from information scattered across papers, released code, and supporting artifacts. For coding agents, reproduction success can therefore depend on their ability to fill in missing details, rather than on the released artifacts alone. We ask whether preserving recovered procedures and decisions improves subsequent independent reproduction. We define a standardized artifact design comprising a refined codebase, environment setup, experiment launchers, and a reproduction guide, and introduce ReproBridge, an agent workflow for constructing these refined reproducible artifacts. ReproBridge-Bench provides 1,029 tasks from 387 experiments across 36 papers, anchored by five human-verified reference scores per task. translated_title: ReproBridge：将可复现性融入机器学习研究产物
translated_abstract: 复现机器学习实验需要从散布于论文、已发布代码和配套产物中的信息来重构实验流程。因此，对编码智能体而言，复现成功与否可能取决于其填补缺失细节的能力，而不仅仅取决于所发布的产物本身。我们探究：保留已恢复出的流程与决策能否改善后续的独立复现。我们定义了一种标准化的产物设计，包含精炼后的代码库、环境配置、实验启动器和复现指南，并提出 ReproBridge——一种用于构建这类精炼可复现产物的智能体工作流。ReproBridge-Bench 提供来自 36 篇论文、387 个实验的 1,029 个任务，每个任务由五个人工核验的参考分数作为锚定基准。智能体在全新会话中使用原始代码或精炼产物尝试任务；由独立的 Auditor 检查执行证据。在四个被评估的模型上，精炼产物……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 ReproBridge 智能体工作流，将散见于论文与代码中的实验流程和决策整合为标准化可复现产物，并构建包含 36 篇论文 1,029 个任务的基准，以检验这类精炼产物能否提升智能体独立复现机器学习实验的能力。
en_tdlr: ReproBridge proposes an agent workflow that consolidates experimental procedures and decisions scattered across papers and code into standardized reproducible artifacts, and introduces a benchmark of 1,029 tasks from 36 papers to evaluate whether such refined artifacts improve agents' independent reproduction of ML experiments.
